method: Original Kolgujev03Bomberman, Malden01TakeTheCar and Everon05HeavyMetal missions; copied profiles, --nosound, native Windows Vulkan synchronization validation,1920x1080,auto/TAA100%,one bounce,RT sunlight/cloud shadows,AO/water/volumetrics off. PBR Off/auto-GI Off/auto-GI On at09:00/17:30; original exterior/interior views, advancing-simulation camera translation/turning and distance retreats. Developer-camera observations, not physical traversal, Steam launch or mission completion.
costMethod: RTX4060Ti/NVIDIA617.14. Native scene workloads; warm10, GI Off/On/On/Off, settle4/sample6, paired interval medians. No build/census/tests during sampling. Frame differences include ordinary variation; not isolated material costs or FPS gains. Raw individual GPU stages and intervals retained.
limits: Exact-model source assessment is not whole-model PBR or all-instance GI coverage. Family counters are half-resolution frame samples and include other scenery. New eligible hit identities are independent reflector evidence. Baked shading/weathering and photographed recess/green-base color remain original artwork; no recovered albedo, measured optics, leaf/fastener optics, normal maps or masks. Narrow source-approved dumruina geometry is not its broad glazed facade.
